text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby trains steadily and quietly. 
Concerned by her cautious approach, her 
Trainer inquires, suspecting something 
might be amiss with her physical 
condition.

Daiichi Ruby was born with a defect in her 
legs. Having dreamed of honoring her 
clan's pride through racing as a child, 
she nearly lost her sense of purpose.

Her parents had supported her devotedly by 
every means possible. Thanks to them, she 
obtained a body capable of enduring the 
fiercest of races.

She will not allow the achievements of the 
"Noble Clan" to end with her generation. 
To repay her great debt of gratitude, 
Daiichi Ruby vows to deliver results.

Meanwhile, the Trainer couldn't bring 
himself to talk to her when her expression 
clouded over. Taking a leaf out of Daitaku 
Helios's book, he vowed to reach out to 
her himself.
